description: Enterprise-grade platform providing APIs for businesses to send and receive WhatsApp messages, manage accounts, and build automated messaging solutions.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth-based Bearer tokens (temporary user access tokens or permanent system user access tokens passed in the Authorization header).
credential_notes: Any developer can sign up for a Meta Developer account for free, create an app, and generate test access tokens and phone number IDs via the Meta App Dashboard.
api_notes: Covers cloud messaging (sending text, media, and templates), webhooks for real-time events, business management, phone number management, groups, media, and profiles.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Meta; only third-party or community integrations exist.
rationale: The WhatsApp Cloud API features a fully documented public REST API and free self-serve developer credentials, allowing developers to immediately build integrations.

evidence.note: Shows the REST API endpoint structure and Bearer token authorization header format.
Details self-serve developer registration, Meta app creation, and generation of access tokens.
Describes messaging features, webhooks, templates, and management capabilities.
Confirms complete setup steps from scratch for developers using free self-serve tools.
